one_common_scale.note: the IDENTICAL episodes of the cross-fitted arms, re-scored with ONE per-tier map (the all-300 Platt fit) instead of five. This isolates how much of the pooled number is the cross-fold scale heterogeneity that cross-fitting a calibration introduces into a cross-clip rank metric. The single map is fitted with all 300 clips' labels, which is a 2-parameter per-tier leak that touches NO decision, only the units of the delivered score; it is reported for exactly that reason and is not the primary.

check_a_references_unchanged.what_must_match: always-cloud and device-only deliver scores from ONE tier only, and a single per-tier monotone map cannot reorder values within a tier, so their challenge mAP must equal StudyE9c's committed 0.5675307471627266 and 0.4776042449177038 and their streaming AP must equal StudyE9b's committed device-only|measured@25|far5 and always-cloud/32BI_N1|measured@25|cad50|far5 at every horizon.
check_a_references_unchanged.explanation: under d3dev there is ONE map per tier for every clip and every fold, so the cross-fitted and the single-map contexts are the same object and the invariance holds EXACTLY in both: the committed references reproduce to machine zero and sanity check (a) passes as written.

check_b_positives_only_oracle.requirement: the positives-only oracle must score at or above device-only on challenge mAP; if it does not, STOP and report

check_c_no_leakage.asserted: every tunable is fitted on exactly the 240 training clips of its fold and train / held-out overlap is 0 in all 5 folds; the CALIBRATION is one map per tier fitted on the 601 StudyD3 Nexar DEV clips, of which 0 are among the 300 evaluation clips, which is strictly stronger than cross-fitting

check_metric_engine.note: the primary is StudyE9b's ApEngine through metrics.streaming_ap's own construction; only the average over horizons 0.5 / 1.0 / 1.5 s is added

fold_rule: within each label stratum, order by sha256(file_name) hex; fold = rank mod 5; pre-registered in research/EXPERIMENTS.md (StudyCTRL1b-crossfit) before any computation
